title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-gpu-iam-networking-migration
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: private deployments have accumulated divergent Terraform state layouts across GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking modules which complicates upgrades and cross-account reuse. This PR unifies the private deployment Terraform state layout, consolidates GPU node pool, IAM, and networking modules under a consistent namespace, and provides a migration path and automation to move existing state without downtime. Changes: 1) move and refactor modules into modules/gpu-node-pool, modules/iam, modules/networking with a shared modules/state/backend.tf that standardizes backend key naming and locking; 2) introduce a migration script scripts/migrate-state.sh which performs a safe state mv plan and can be run in dry-run mode; 3) update examples/private-deploy and the README with step-by-step upgrade/rollback instructions; 4) add a compatibility shim that preserves previous resource addresses for one release to avoid immediate breakage; 5) add automated acceptance tests for state migration and smoke tests in CI. Backwards compatibility: this PR maintains address aliases for legacy state for a single release window and includes an explicit opt-in flag in the module root for immediate enforcement. Migration plan: 1) run terraform init with the new backend config and validate; 2) run scripts/migrate-state.sh --dry-run in staging to verify plan; 3) run script without --dry-run in staging and monitor infra metrics and onboarding tests; 4) roll forward to production during a low-traffic window and have the rollback steps ready (scripts/migrate-state.sh --rollback uses a saved snapshot key). Testing and CI: terraform validate and fmt run on every PR; a dedicated integration job runs terraform apply against a disposable GCP account using n1-standard nodes with mock GPUs; migration acceptance tests run nightly for this branch. Security and IAM: consolidated IAM role creation to a single module with minimal privilege policy changes; added audit-log enabling by default for newly created projects. Docs: expanded examples/private-deploy/upgrade.md with full commands and prechecks. Risk and mitigation: this is a high-impact change to state layout; mitigations include a dry-run migration path, one-release compatibility shim, and automated rollback. Implementation notes: split refactor into small commits to make the review easier, included a migration runner that requires linear ticket for execution, and left feature flag off by default. See checklist below. Checklist: [x] terraform fmt/validate passing [x] migration script implemented [x] upgrade docs added [x] integration tests for migration [x] reviewers approved [x] CI green except one flaky smoke test that was retried and passed
